text: AI-powered toys, from left, Miko 3, Alilo Smart AI Bunny, FoloToy Sunflower and Curio Grok. Matt Nighswander / NBC News Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 24, 2026, 5:00 AM EST / Updated Nov. 24, 2026, 10:23 PM EST By Emily Lorsch and Jared Perlo New York Gov. Kathy Hochul signed a bill Tuesday banning for five years the manufacture and sale of toys powered by AI chatbots. The law is slated to take effect in February across New York, the second state to ban the toys after California.
